item.description: Label: Groovin Records | Prix: 16,00 € | Style: House , Deep House , Classic House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Groovin Records

Prix: 16,00 €

Style: House , Deep House , Classic House

Real proper house music from the legendary Allen Jovonn Armstrong. Originally released in 1995 on New York City's Kult Records, "Satisfied" is a true classic from the underground for those who know. We're loving the standout Moodyfied mix: a stripped down, moody back room dub that begs to be played in a dark basement, while on the flip it's all about the soulful and emotive swing of "I'm Waiting". The rather pumping "After Life" which perfectly captures the zeitgeist of the early '90s sound coming out of The Big Apple is rather good too.

Tracklist:

  • A1. Satisfied (Moodyfied mix)
  • A2. Satisfied (Satisfied Moov)
  • B1. I'm Waiting
  • B2. After Life

item.title: Peven Everett - Stuck
item.description: Label: Groovin Records | Prix: 20,00 € | Style: House , Deep House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Groovin Records

Prix: 20,00 €

Style: House , Deep House

20 years after it first landed on Bobby and Steve's Soul Heaven Records imprint - once the UK's foremost soulful house outlet - Peven Everett's 'Stuck' returns to stores via a must-check reissue specialists Groovin' Records. Wisely, the Italian outfit has chosen to showcase two of the more celebrated and sought-after rubs. On side A, Danny Krivit delivers a lovely 12-minute edit in which Everett's effortlessly soulful vocals ride hypnotic, soft-touch drums, jazzy guitar licks, warming bass guitar and jammed-out electric piano keys. Krivit's version has long been an anthem at Body & Soul NYC and remains a fine, stretched-out revision. The late Phil Asher takes over on side B, balancing soulful deep house jazziness with a more driving garage-house groove.

Tracklist:

  • A1. Stuck (Danny Krivit re-edit)
  • B1. Stuck (Phil Asher's Soul Heaven remix)

item.title: Westcoast Goddess - Flute Dreams
item.description: Label: D3 Elements | Prix: 16,00 € | Style: Deep House , House , Jazz
item.content:encoded:
Label: D3 Elements

Prix: 16,00 €

Style: Deep House , House , Jazz

The A-side delivers two sublime cuts drenched in that unmistakable Italo-Balearic magic. Warm chords, sun-kissed melodies and effortless grooves transport you straight back to the golden days of mid-’90s Italian house music. Eyes closed, you’re cruising along the Riviera with the top down, lost in pure bliss. Flip it over and the mood shifts firmly toward the dancefloor. The B-side explores deeper territory, moving through a range of shades while keeping things locked into a tough, club- focused framework. There’s a distinct New York stomp running through these tracks—driving, hypnotic and full of attitude— yet they never lose the emotional depth and musicality that have become a Westcoast Goddess trademark. Just when you think the journey is complete, the EP saves its ace for last. Closing things out is a hypnotic funk groove built around silky Rhodes, a tight rhythm section and an iconic bassline—a fitting finale that leaves a lasting impression.

Tracklist:

  • 1. Passionata
  • 2. Flute Dreams
  • 3. The Sensitive Case (House Mix)
  • 4. Proto
  • 5. The Sensitive Case (House Mix)

item.title: Wax Fruit - Whispers
item.description: Label: Chiwax | Prix: 16,00 € | Style: House, Classic House
item.content:encoded:
Label: Chiwax

Prix: 16,00 €

Style: House, Classic House

Chiwax are back this week with a more than welcome reissue of Wax Fruit's one-and-only release Whispers from 1994. This was one of many aliases sussed by Toronto-based producer Ron Allen, who some of you may know for his seminal work as one half of Psyance (with Hayden Andre Brown) who released on Plus 8, as well as his work under the names Aztech, The Apache Project and The R.A.S.E. The late night mood music of the title track is a true zeitgeist from the period in which it was released, while the looped-up disco sampling deep house of 'Just A Party' or 'Mindgames' over on the flip were equally as trendsetting as anything fellow Torontonians like Nick Holder or DJ Sneak were making at the time.

  • A2.Just A Party
  • B1.Be Yourself

item.title: Swayzak - Floyd
item.description: Label: Rawax Germany | Prix: 15,00 € | Style: House , Classic house
item.content:encoded:
Label: Rawax Germany

Prix: 15,00 €

Style: House , Classic house

First released in 1999, Swayzak's 'Floyd/Doobie' shook the British duo's catalogue. Though it wasn't 'Bueno' or 'Fukumachi', this deep house cut was the next best choice for followers of the then burgeoning tech house circuit. Swayzak were already favourites on this and the deep house scene, and had clawed in acclaim for their involvement in both as early as 1993. One particularly prolix bio deems them the incipients of "1st wave 2000-era progressive deep minimal", which is too analytic even for us manic categorisers. No, we prefer to take these two big-hitters as they are: brimming with enthusiasm for a gadget-packed future, 'Floyd' fizzes and twitches with the pulsing blurts of a saw synth, as if to suggest constant magnetic stimulation from above. 'Doobie', meanwhile, hears our protagonist disrobe the techno utility belt, returning to a wireless home, so to gaze out over a subtly detuned chord landscape set to munching percs.

Tracklist:

  • A1.Floyd
  • B1. Doobie

item.description: Label: Rawax Germany | Prix: 16,00 € | Style: Disco House , Detroit House
item.content:encoded:

Style: Disco House , Detroit House

Gerald Mitchell - the Detroit keyboardist and producer perhaps best known by his UR aliases Hardlife, 044 and The Deacon - revives his less celebrated but equally power-packed Los Hermanos project for 'Keep Hold Tight', the fourth release in the Motor City Edition series with Rawax. Title urger 'Keep Hold Tight' brings snippeted radio funk and a glistening down-coat of neon pads - holding us in tight-roped suspense - while 'Hey You' flips into a more morphotic beatjazz groove, though not without a reliable four-kick-drive foundation. 'Lifted Soul' and 'The Descendant' further minimalise the B-side in adroit Detroit manner.
